title: Ommaviy nutq va notiqlik
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ingliz tilida ishontiruvchi ommaviy nutq so‘zlay olasiz: notiqlik usullari (rhetorical devices), sur’at va pauzalar, tinglovchini jalb qilish va esda qoladigan yakun.

scenes.title: Ommaviy nutq va notiqlik
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda grafik va ma’lumotlarni ingliz tilida tushuntirishni o‘rgandik. Bugun esa ma’lumotni odamlarga yetkazish san’ati — ommaviy nutq va notiqlikni o‘rganamiz: notiqlik usullari, sur’at va pauzalar, tinglovchini jalb qilish va esda qoladigan yakun. IELTS Speaking, konferensiyalar va kasbiy taqdimotlar uchun bu eng kuchli qurol. Dars oxirida 4 daqiqalik ishontiruvchi nutqning to‘liq rejasini olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome to lesson five. Today we learn the art of persuasive public speaking: rhetorical devices, pace and pauses, engaging the audience and memorable conclusions.
scenes.say_uz: Beshinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Bugun ishontiruvchi ommaviy nutq san’atini o‘rganamiz: notiqlik usullari, sur’at va pauzalar, tinglovchini jalb qilish va esda qoladigan yakunlar.

scenes.title: Nutq anatomiyasi: hook, thesis, uch nuqta, yakun

examples.t: Imagine a city where no journey takes longer than fifteen minutes.
examples.uz: Bir tasavvur qiling: hech bir yo‘l o‘n besh daqiqadan oshmaydigan shahar.

examples.t: Today I will argue that cities should be redesigned for people, not cars.
examples.uz: Bugun shaharlar mashinalar uchun emas, odamlar uchun qayta loyihalanishi kerak, deb isbotlamoqchiman.

scenes.say_native: Kuchli nutq to‘rt qavatdan iborat. Birinchisi — hook — ilgaki — dastlabki o‘n besh soniya — savol, hikoya yoki shokga soluvchi fakt — tinglovchi qaror qiladi: tinglaymanmi yoki yo‘qmi. Ikkinchisi — thesis — bir gapli asosiy xabar — “Today I will argue that…” — bugun … deb isbotlamoqchiman. Uchinchisi — uchta dalil — uchlik qoidasi — odam miyasi uchlikni oson eslab qoladi — “first, second, third” yoki “why, how, what”. To‘rtinchisi — yakun — ochilishdagi ilgakka qaytish — “callback” — va harakatga chaqirish. Eslab qoling: nutq — insho emas — u quloqqa yoziladi, ko‘zga emas.
scenes.say: A strong speech has four layers: a hook in fifteen seconds, a one-sentence thesis, three points, and a callback conclusion with a call to action.
scenes.say_uz: Kuchli nutq to‘rt qavatdan iborat: o‘n besh soniyalik hook, bir gapli thesis, uchta nuqta va callback hamda harakatga chaqiriqdan iborat yakun.

scenes.title: Hook yozish: savol, hikoya, raqam, keskin da’vo

examples.t: Eight out of ten meetings could have been an email.
examples.uz: O‘nta uchrashuvdan sakkiztasi email bo‘lishi mumkin edi.

examples.t: Let me tell you about the day our server crashed at 3 a.m.
examples.uz: Sizga ertalab soat uchda serverimiz ishdan chiqqan kun haqida aytib beray.

scenes.say_native: Hookning to‘rtta turi. Birinchisi — ritorik savol: “What if cities were designed for people?” — agar shaharlar odamlar uchun loyihalansa-yu? — javob kutilmaydi, o‘ylashga majbur qiladi. Ikkinchisi — hikoya — “Let me tell you about…” — bir voqeani 30 soniyada ayting — odam to‘ldirilsa ham tinglaydi. Uchinchisi — shokga soluvchi raqam: “Eight out of ten meetings could have been an email” — juda keng tarqalgan iborani burchak bilan ayting — tinglovchi kulib, e’tibor beradi. To‘rtinchisi — keskin da’vo: “The traditional office is dead” — an’anaviy ofis o‘lgan — bahsli, lekin diqqatni tortadi. Eslab qoling: hook tinglovchining e’tiborini olish uchun — xavfsiz emas, jasur bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Four hooks: a rhetorical question, a short anecdote, a shocking statistic, or a bold claim. The opening must grab attention in fifteen seconds.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta hook: ritorik savol, qisqa hikoya, shokga soluvchi statistika yoki keskin da’vo. Ochilish o‘n besh soniyada e’tiborni tortishi kerak.

scenes.title: Hook yozish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Mavzu: yoshlarni ko‘proq o‘qishga jalb qilish. Uchta turli hook yozing: birinchisi — shokga soluvchi raqam — “So‘nggi yilda o‘qilgan kitoblar soni 40 foizga kamaydi” kabi — lekin ixtiro qiling, raqam mantiqiy bo‘lsin. Ikkinchisi — ritorik savol — nima uchun yoshlar kitob o‘qimay qo‘ydi? Uchinchi — qisqa hikoya — telefon ekranidan kitobga qaytish haqida ikki gaplik hikoya. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda o‘qing.
scenes.say: Write three different hooks for a talk on getting young people to read more: a shocking statistic, a rhetorical question, and a two-sentence anecdote. Deliver them aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Yoshlarni ko‘proq o‘qishga jalb qilish mavzusida uchta turli hook yozing: shokga soluvchi raqam, ritorik savol va ikki gaplik hikoya. Ularni baland ovozda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: hook mashqi
board: “Only one in five teenagers finished a book last year.”
“When did you last read a whole book?”
“I watched my nephew choose a game over a novel…”
scenes.say_native: Javob namunalari. Statistika: “Only one in five teenagers finished a book last year” — besh yoshdan faqat bittasi kitob tugatdi — shokga soluvchi. Ritorik savol: “When did you last read a whole book?” — oxirgi marta qachon kitob o‘qidingiz? — tinglovchini o‘ylantiradi. Hikoya: “I watched my nephew choose a game over a novel, then blame the education system” — jiyanim o‘yinni kitobdan afzal ko‘rdi, keyin ta’lim tizimini aybladi — odamga xos. Sizning variantlaringiz boshqacha — muhimi birinchi o‘n besh soniyada tinglovchi “keyingi gapni eshitsam bo‘ladimi?” deb so‘rasin.
scenes.say: Models: only one in five teenagers finished a book last year. When did you last read a whole book? I watched my nephew choose a game over a novel.
scenes.say_uz: Namunalar: o‘tgan yili besh yoshdan faqat bittasi kitobni tugatdi. Oxirgi marta qachon butun kitob o‘qidingiz? Jiyanim o‘yinni romandan afzal ko‘rdi, deb kuzatdim.

scenes.title: Ritorik usullari 1: takror va uchlik qoidasi
board: Rule of three: “of the people, by the people, for the people”

examples.t: We will cut waste, we will invest in schools, we will protect the future.
examples.uz: Biz isrofni kamaytiramiz, maktablarga sarmoya kiritamiz, kelajakni himoya qilamiz.

examples.t: Government of the people, by the people, for the people.
examples.uz: Xalqning hukumati, xalq tomonidan, xalq uchun.

scenes.say_native: Notiqlikning eng kuchli ikki usuli. Birinchi — anaphora — gap boshidagi so‘zning takrori: “We will cut waste, we will invest in schools, we will protect the future” — biz isrofni kamaytiramiz, maktablarga sarmoya kiritamiz, kelajakni himoya qilamiz — uch marta “we will” — ritm yaratadi, tinglovchi takror orqali yodda saqlaydi. Bu bevosita Martin Luther King’ning “I have a dream” uslubining asosi — bitta iborani uch marta takrorlash. Ikkinchi — uchlik qoidasi — rule of three — uchta bir xil tuzilma — “of the people, by the people, for the people” — xalqning, xalq tomonidan, xalq uchun — uch embrioni eslab qolish inson miyasiga oson. Eslab qoling: anaphora — yozilgan takror, tricolon — uchlik — ikkalasini birlashtirish eng kuchli effektni beradi.
scenes.say: Two powerful devices: anaphora — repeating the opening words, as in we will cut, we will invest, we will protect — and the rule of three — of the people, by the people, for the people.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki kuchli usul: anaphora — boshidagi so‘zlarni takrorlash — biz kamaytiramiz, biz sarmoya kiritamiz, biz himoya qilamiz — va uchlik qoidasi — xalqning, xalq tomonidan, xalq uchun.

scenes.title: Ritorik usullari 2: ritorik savol, qarama-qarshilik, ko‘chma ma’no

examples.t: How much longer can we afford to ignore climate change?
examples.uz: Biz iqlim o‘zgarishiga yana qancha e’tiborsiz qaray olamiz?

examples.t: Ask not what your country can do for you — ask what you can do for your country.
examples.uz: Mamlakatingiz siz uchun nima qila olishini emas, siz mamlakatingiz uchun nima qila olishingizni so‘rang.

scenes.say_native: Yana uchta usul. Birinchisi — ritorik savol: “How much longer can we afford to ignore climate change?” — biz iqlim o‘zgarishini yana qancha e’tiborsiz qoldira olamiz? — javob kutilmaydi, lekin har bir tinglovchi o‘zi javob topadi — ichki konsensus paydo bo‘ladi. Ikkinchisi — antithesis — qarama-qarshilik — ikki qarama-qarshi g‘oyani yonma-yon qo‘yish: Kennedy’ning “Ask not what your country can do for you — ask what you can do for your country” — eng mashhur namunasi — tuzilma yodda qoladi. Uchinchisi — metafora — ko‘chma ma’no — murakkab g‘oyani oddiy obraz orqali: “The economy is a garden — it needs weeding, watering, patience” — iqtisodiyot — bog‘ — begona o‘tlardan tozalashni, sug‘orishni, sabrni talab qiladi — mavhum g‘oya ko‘z oldida jonlanadi. Eslab qoling: metafora faqat yangi bo‘lsa — eski metafora tinglovchini zeriktiradi.
scenes.say: More devices: rhetorical questions that the audience answers silently, antithesis — pairing opposites like Kennedy — and a fresh metaphor that makes an abstract idea concrete.
scenes.say_uz: Yana usullar: tinglovchi ichida javob beradigan ritorik savollar, qarama-qarshiliklarni yonma-yon qo‘yish — Kennedy kabi — va mavhum g‘oyani jonlantiradigan yangi metafora.

scenes.title: Ritorik usullar mashqi
scenes.say_native: Mavzu: “Nega har shaharda kutubxona kerak?” Uchta usul bilan ishlang. Birinchi: uchlik qoidasi — “A library is a school, a shelter and a community” kabi — uchtasini siz tanlang. Ikkinchi: ritorik savol — kutubxonasiz shahar qanday bo‘ladi? Uchinchi: metafora — kutubxonani bog‘ga, yoki oshxonaga, yoki… obrazga aylantiring. Har birini ingliz tilida to‘liq gapda yozing va baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Topic: why every city needs a library. Write a rule of three sentence, one rhetorical question, and one fresh metaphor. Deliver all three aloud in English.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu: har shaharga nega kutubxona kerak. Uchlik qoidasi gapi, bitta ritorik savol va bitta yangi metafora yozing. Uchchalasini ham ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: ritorik usullar mashqi
board: “A library is a school, a shelter, a home for ideas.”
“What happens to a city that stops reading?”
“A library is the gym of the mind.”
scenes.say_native: Javob namunalari. Uchlik: “A library is a school, a shelter and a home for ideas” — maktab, boshpana, g‘oyalar uyi — uch so‘z yodda qoladi. Ritorik savol: “What happens to a city that stops reading?” — o‘qishni to‘xtatgan shahar bo‘ylab nima bo‘ladi? — jim lekin kuchli. Metafora: “A library is the gym of the mind” — kutubxona — aqlning sport zali — qisqa va yangi. Sizning javoblaringiz farq qilishi mumkin — muhimi har biri bitta fokusda va yodda qoladigan bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Models: a library is a school, a shelter and a home for ideas; what happens to a city that stops reading; a library is the gym of the mind.
scenes.say_uz: Namunalar: kutubxona maktab, boshpana va g‘oyalar uyidir; o‘qishni to‘xtatgan shaharga nima bo‘ladi; kutubxona — aqlning sport zali.

scenes.title: Sur’at, pauzalar va urg‘u: ovoz rejissyori bo‘ling
board: Slow down for key points — sekinlang
Pause after the thesis — thesisdan keyin to‘xtang
Stress the noun / verb — urg‘u so‘z ildiziga

examples.uz: (pauza) Uchta raqam. (pauza) O‘ttiz. O‘ttiz besh. Qirq.

examples.t: This is not a cost — it is an investment.

scenes.say_native: Yaxshi matn yomon yetkazilsa o‘ladi — shuning uchun sur’at va urg‘u muhim. Birinchisi — sur’at — asosiy fikrni sekin ayting — odam daqiqasiga 150-160 so‘z bilan qulay tinglaydi — muhim joyda 120-ga sekinlang. Ikkinchisi — pauzalar — pauza sukut emas, u ta’kid belgisi — “This is not a cost. (pauza) It is an investment” — thesisdan keyin yarim soniya to‘xtang — tinglovchi o‘zi to‘ldiradi. Uchinchisi — urg‘u — ma’noli so‘zga urg‘u bering — ot yoki fe’l ildiziga — “This is YOUR future” — “not a COST, but an INVESTment” — qarama-qarshi urg‘ular. Eslab qoling: tez nutq — hayajon, sekin nutq — ishonch — ishontiruvchi nutq ko‘pincha sekin.
scenes.say: Slow down for key ideas — aim for around 120 words per minute at the climax. Pause half a second after your thesis. Stress nouns and verbs, not small grammar words.
scenes.say_uz: Asosiy g‘oyalar uchun sekinlang — cho‘qqida daqiqasiga taxminan 120 so‘zga qo‘ying. Thesisdan keyin yarim soniya to‘xtang. Ot va fe’llarga urg‘u bering, kichik grammatik so‘zlarga emas.

scenes.title: Urg‘u va pauza mashqi
board: Bir marta tez, bir marta sekin
scenes.say_native: Bitta gapni uch xil usulda ayting: “We will not wait” — biz kutmaymiz. Birinchi usul — tez, hayajon bilan. Ikkinchi usul — sekin, ishonch bilan. Uchinchi usul — “We will (yarim soniya) not (yarim soniya) wait” — har so‘z orasida pauza. Yozib oling — o‘zingizni eshiting — qaysi variant ishonchliroq tuyuladi? Ovoz balandligi va sur’atingiz qanday o‘zgardi? Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Say “We will not wait” three ways: fast with urgency, slow with conviction, and with half-second pauses between each word. Record yourself and notice the difference.
scenes.say_uz: “We will not wait” jumlasi — biz kutmaymiz — uch xil usulda: tez, hayajon bilan; sekin, ishonch bilan; har so‘z orasida yarim soniyalik pauzalar bilan. Yozib oling va farqni eshiting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: urg‘u mashqi
scenes.say_native: Har uch variant ham to‘g‘ri — lekin maqsadga qarab farq qiladi. Tez versiya — chaqiruv va harakat kayfiyatini beradi. Sekin versiya — jiddiy va ishontiruvchi. Pauzali versiya — eng dramatik va eng esda qoladigan. Kasbiy nutqda uchtasining ham o‘rni bor — lekin hech qachon “monotone” — bir xil ohang — bo‘lmang: ovozning balandligi, sur’ati va urg‘usi — bu sizning asboblaringiz.
scenes.say: All three are valid: fast conveys urgency, slow conveys conviction, pauses convey drama. The fatal flaw is monotone — vary pitch, pace and stress deliberately.
scenes.say_uz: Uchchalasi ham to‘g‘ri: tez — shoshilinch, sekin — ishonch, pauzalar — dramatik ta’sir beradi. Halokatli nuqson esa monotone — bir xil ohang — balandlik, sur’at va urg‘uni atayin o‘zgartiring.

scenes.title: Tinglovchini jalb qilish: you, savollar, hikoyalar, we

examples.t: How many of you have sat through a boring meeting this month?
examples.uz: Bu oyda zerikarli yig‘ilishda o‘tirganingiz nechtasingiz?

examples.t: We all know the feeling of a Monday morning.
examples.uz: Biz hammamiz dushanba ertalabki kayfiyatni bilamiz.

scenes.say_native: Tinglovchi passiv kuzatuvchi bo‘lmasligi kerak — siz uni ishtirokchiga aylantiring. To‘rtta usul. Birinchi — to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri murojaat: “You know this feeling” — siz bu tuyg‘uni bilasiz — “you” so‘zi odamni o‘z ichiga tortadi. Ikkinchi — savollar: “How many of you…?” — qo‘l ko‘tarin — hatto katta zalda siz o‘zingizga savol berishga majbursiz. Uchinchi — hikoya va misollar — fakt esda qolmaydi, hikoya esda qoladi — tadqiqotlar hikoyalarni faktlardan bir necha barobar yaxshiroq eslab qolinishini ko‘rsatadi. To‘rtinchi — birlashtiruvchi “we” — “we all know…” — hammamiz bilamiz — notiq va tinglovchi bir guruh — qarama-qarshilik emas, hamkorlik. Eslab qoling: nutq — o‘qilmaydi, muloqot qilinadi.
scenes.say: Make the audience a participant: address them as you, ask questions, tell stories and examples — they stick. Use inclusive we to create one group.
scenes.say_uz: Tinglovchini ishtirokchiga aylantiring: siz deb murojaat qiling, savollar bering, hikoya va misollar keltiring — ular esda qoladi. Birlashtiruvchi we — biz — bitta guruh hissini yaratadi.

scenes.title: Quruq ma’ruza va jonli nutq
board: ✗ “Today I will talk about climate data.”
✓ “Last summer, the river near my house dried up.”
✓ look at people, vary your voice

examples.t: Look at them. Speak to them. Not to your notes.
examples.uz: Ularga qarang. Ularga gapiring. Konspektlaringizga emas.

scenes.say_native: Foydalanuvchilar ikkita asosiy xatoga yo‘l qo‘yadi. Birinchi — quruq ochilish: “Today I will talk about climate data” — mavzu to‘g‘ri, lekin hech kim tinglamaydi — to‘g‘risi hikoya: “Last summer, the river near my house dried up” — o‘tgan yozda uyim yonidagi daryo qurib qoldi — obraz — tinglovchi darhol ichida. Ikkinchi — monotone o‘qish — qog‘ozga tikilish — tinglovchi bilan ko‘z aloqasi yo‘q. To‘g‘risi: odamlarga qarang, ovozingizni o‘zgartiring, sahna bo‘ylab harakatlaning. Ingliz tilidagi mashhur qoida: “Facts tell, stories sell” — faktlar aytadi, hikoyalar ishontiradi. Eslab qoling: matn tayyorlang, lekin nutqni odamga ayting.
scenes.say: Two fatal errors: opening with a dry announcement — open with a story instead — and reading monotone from notes. Look at people, vary your voice, move. Facts tell, stories sell.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki halokatli xato: quruq e’londan boshlash — o‘rniga hikoyadan boshlang — va konspektni monotone o‘qish. Odamlarga qarang, ovozingizni o‘zgartiring, harakatlaning. Faktlar aytadi, hikoyalar ishontiradi.

scenes.title: Tinglovchini jalb qilish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Mavzu: “Nega uxlash g‘ayrioddiy kuchli qurolimiz?” Uchta jalb qiluvchi element yozing: birinchi gap — tinglovchiga “you” bilan murojaat — “You have probably felt…” kabi. Ikkinchi — savol — “How many of you slept less than seven hours last night?” uchinchi — 20 soniyalik hikoya — qachondir uyqusiz qolgan kuningiz haqida. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting — tinglovchiga qarab.
scenes.say: Topic: why sleep is our superpower. Write one sentence addressing the audience with you, one question, and a twenty-second personal anecdote. Deliver all three aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu: nega uxlash g‘ayrioddiy kuchli qurollarimiz. Tinglovchiga you bilan bitta gap, bitta savol va yigirma soniyalik shaxsiy hikoya yozing. Uchalasini ham baland ovozda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: jalb qilish mashqi
board: “You know the feeling of a 3 p.m. crash…”
“How many of you slept under seven hours?”
“Last winter I ran on four hours for a week…”
scenes.say_native: Javob namunalari. Murojaat: “You know the feeling of a three p.m. crash” — siz soat uchdagi sekinlashuvni bilasiz — har kim o‘zini taniydi. Savol: “How many of you slept under seven hours?” — qo‘llar ko‘tariladi — ishtirok. Hikoya: “Last winter I ran on four hours for a week, and I was useless by Thursday” — o‘tgan qishda bir hafta to‘rt soat uxladim, payshanbaga kelib nofoydaga aylandim — kuldirish va ishontirish bir vaqtda. Eslab qoling: eng yaxshi hikoya — sizning hikoyangiz.
scenes.say: Models: you know the feeling of a three p.m. crash; how many of you slept under seven hours; last winter I ran on four hours for a week.
scenes.say_uz: Namunalar: siz soat uchdagi tanazzulni bilasiz; nechtasingiz o‘tgan tun yetti soatdan kam uxladingiz; o‘tgan qish bir hafta to‘rt soat bilan ishladim.

scenes.title: Esda qoladigan yakun: callback, chaqiriq, oxirgi ibora
board: Call to action — bitta aniq qadam

examples.t: Remember the river that dried up? So do I. Every single day.
examples.uz: Qurib qolgan daryoni esladingizmi? Men ham eslayman. Har bir kun.

examples.t: Start tonight. One page. That is all I ask.
examples.uz: Bugun kechasi boshlang. Bitta sahifa. Men sizdan shuni so‘rayman, xolos.

scenes.say_native: Yakun — nutqning eng esda qoladigan qismi — chunki u oxirgi so‘z. Uchta element. Birinchisi — callback — ochilishdagi hookka qaytish — “Remember the river that dried up? So do I” — hikoya yopildi — doira yopildi. Ikkinchisi — call to action — bitta aniq qadam — “Start tonight. One page” — bugun kechasi boshlang, bitta sahifa — tinglovchi nima qilishini biladi. Uchinchisi — quotable line — bitta jumlta — “The future belongs to those who read” — kelajak o‘qiydiganlarniki — iqtibos sifatida tarqaladigan yakuniy gap. Eslab qoling: yomon boshlangan nutq zo‘r yakun bilan saqlanib qolishi mumkin — yaxshi boshlangan nutq yomon yakun bilan yo‘qoladi.
scenes.say: End memorably: call back to your opening, give one clear call to action — tonight, one page — and finish on a single quotable line people repeat.
scenes.say_uz: Esda qoladigan yakun: ochilishingizga callback qiling, bitta aniq harakatga chaqiriq bering — bugun kechasi, bitta sahifa — va odamlar takrorlaydigan bitta quotable line bilan yakunlang.

scenes.title: TINGLANG 1: nutq ochilishi va yakuni
board: Thesis: “Cities should be designed for people.”
Close: “Remember the river. So will they.”
scenes.say_native: Birinchi misolni tinglang — bir nutqning ochilishi va yakuni. Ochilish: “Imagine a city where no journey takes longer than fifteen minutes — where the school, the market and the park are all a short walk away. Today I will argue that our cities should be designed for people, not for cars.” — tasavvur qiling: hech bir yo‘l o‘n besh daqiqadan oshmaydigan — maktab, bozor va park yaqin — bugun shaharlar odamlar uchun loyihalanishi kerak deb isbotlamoqchiman. Yakun: “So — remember the fifteen-minute city. It is not a dream. It is a decision. And the decision is ours.” — xo‘sh — o‘n besh daqiqalik shaharni eslang — u orzu emas — qaror — va qaror bizniki. Diqqat qiling: ochilish “Imagine” — tasavvur qiling — bilan; yakun “the decision is ours” — qaror bizniki — bilan — doira to‘liq yopildi.
scenes.say: Imagine a city where no journey takes longer than fifteen minutes. Today I will argue that cities should be designed for people, not cars. So remember the fifteen-minute city. It is a decision, and the decision is ours.
scenes.say_uz: Tasavvur qiling: hech bir yo‘l o‘n besh daqiqadan oshmaydigan shahar. Bugun shaharlar mashinalar uchun emas, odamlar uchun loyihalanishi kerak deb isbotlamoqchiman. Xo‘sh, o‘n besh daqiqalik shaharni eslang. U qaror, va qaror bizniki.

scenes.title: Suhbat 1 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Suhbat bo‘yicha to‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: nutq qaysi so‘z bilan boshlanadi — qaysi hook ishlatilgan? Ikkinchi: thesis nima — bir gap bilan ayting. Uchinchi: ochilishdagi asosiy obraz nima — o‘n besh daqiqa nimaga ishora? To‘rtinchi: yakun ochilishga qanday ulanadi — qaysi ibora qaytariladi? Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Answer: how does the speech open, what is the thesis in one sentence, what is the fifteen-minute image, and how does the ending call back to the opening?
scenes.say_uz: Javob bering: nutq qanday boshlanadi, thesis bir gapda nima, o‘n besh daqiqalik tasavvur nimaga ishora qiladi va yakun ochilishga qanday ulanadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 1
board: “It is a decision, and the decision is ours”
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Nutq “Imagine” — tasavvur qiling — bilan boshlanadi — klassik hook. Thesis: shaharlar odamlar uchun — mashinalar uchun emas. O‘n besh daqiqalik shahar — hamma narsa piyoda masofada — ilgaki obraz. Yakun: “It is a decision, and the decision is ours” — ochilishning “imagine”iga javob — qaror bizniki — callback to‘liq. Mana — aylanma nutq tuzilishining namunasi: ochilish va yakun bir-birini to‘ldiradi.
scenes.say: Answers: it opens with imagine; the thesis is cities for people, not cars; fifteen minutes is walkable convenience; the ending answers the opening with it is a decision, and the decision is ours.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: nutq imagine bilan boshlanadi; thesis — shaharlar odamlar uchun, mashinalar uchun emas; o‘n besh daqiqa — piyoda yetish mumkinligi; yakun ochilishga “bu qaror va qaror bizniki” deb javob beradi.

scenes.title: TINGLANG 2: ikki hamkasb nutqni tanqid qilmoqda
board: B: But I read it like an essay…
A: Pause more. Look at people.
B: I’ll try the three-beat ending.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbatni tinglang — ikki hamkasb nutqni tanqid qilmoqda. A: “Your opening was strong, but you rushed the middle” — ochilishingiz kuchli edi, lekin o‘rtasini shoshildingiz. B: “I read it like an essay” — bilaman, uni konspekt kabi o‘qidim. A: “Pause after your thesis. Look at people” — thesisingizdan keyin to‘xtang, odamlarga qarang. B: “And the ending?” — yakun-chi? A: “Give us one line we can repeat” — biz takrorlay oladigan bitta gap bering. B: “Start tonight, one page, that is all I ask.” — bugun kechasi boshlang, bitta sahifa, shu. A: “Now you have a speech.” — endi sizda nutq bor.
scenes.say: Your opening was strong, but you rushed the middle. I read it like an essay. Pause after your thesis. Look at people. And the ending — give us one line we can repeat. I’ll try: start tonight, one page.
scenes.say_uz: Ochilishingiz kuchli edi, lekin o‘rtasini shoshildingiz. Men uni insho kabi o‘qidim. Thesisingizdan keyin to‘xtang. Odamlarga qarang. Va yakun — biz takrorlay oladigan bitta gap bering. Sinab ko‘raman: bugun kechasi boshlang, bitta sahifa.

scenes.title: Suhbat 2 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: A nutqning qaysi qismini maqtadi? Ikkinchi: B o‘rta qism nima bilan muammo ekanini qanday tasvirladi — “insho kabi”? Uchinchi: A qaysi ikki maslahat berdi — pauza va nima? To‘rtinchi: B yangi yakun sifatida nima aytadi — to‘liq qaytaring. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Answer: which part did A praise, how did B describe the middle, what two tips did A give, and what is B’s new closing line?
scenes.say_uz: Javob bering: A qaysi qismni maqtadi, B o‘rtani qanday tasvirladi, A qaysi ikki maslahat berdi va B ning yangi yakun gapi nima?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. A ochilishni maqtadi — hook ishladi. B o‘rtani “insho kabi o‘qidim” deb tan oldi — rushed. A maslahatlari: thesisdan keyin pauza va ekranga emas, odamlarga ko‘z tashlang. B ning yangi yakuni: “Start tonight, one page, that is all I ask” — bugun kechasi boshlang, bitta sahifa, men sizdan shuni so‘rayman — aniq, qisqa, takrorlanadigan. Notiqlikning butun sehri shu suhbatda: matn yaxshi bo‘lsin, lekin yetkazish yanada muhim.
scenes.say: Answers: A praised the opening; B admitted reading the middle like an essay; A advised pausing after the thesis and looking at people; the new close is start tonight, one page, that is all I ask.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: A ochilishni maqtadi; B o‘rtani insho kabi o‘qiganini tan oldi; A thesisdan keyin pauza va odamlarga qarashni maslahat berdi; yangi yakun — bugun kechasi boshlang, bitta sahifa, men sizdan shuni so‘rayman.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: 4 daqiqalik nutq rejasi
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Istalgan mavzu tanlang — kitob o‘qish, sport, texnologiya. To‘rt daqiqalik nutq rejasini yozing: hook (30 soniya), thesis (10 soniya), uch nuqta (har biri 45-60 soniya), callback yakun (30 soniya). Har bir bo‘limga qaysi ritorik usullarni ishlatishingizni yozing — masalan, hookda raqam, birinchi nuqtada anaphora, yakunda chaqiriq. Keyin ingliz tilida baland ovozda faqat ochilishni va yakunni ayting.
scenes.say: Final task: plan a four-minute speech — hook, thesis, three points with timings, a callback close — and note which rhetorical device you use in each part. Deliver the opening and closing aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy vazifa: to‘rt daqiqalik nutq rejasini tuzing — hook, thesis, vaqtlari bilan uch nuqta, callback yakun — va har qismda qaysi ritorik usulni ishlatishingizni yozing. Ochilish va yakunni baland ovozda ayting.

scenes.title: Namuna nutq parchasi: “The case for reading”

examples.t: Reading builds empathy, reading builds focus, reading builds freedom.
examples.uz: O‘qish empatiya quradi, o‘qish e’tiborni quradi, o‘qish ozodlikni quradi.

scenes.say_native: Namuna nutqni ko‘ring — “The case for reading”. Ochilish: “Only one in five teenagers finished a book last year. Something precious is slipping away — and I believe we can take it back.” — besh yoshdan biri kitob tugatdi — qadrli narsa qo‘limizdan chiqmoqda — va men uni qaytarish mumkin deb ishonaman. Thesis: “Reading builds the mind like nothing else.” — o‘qish aqlni hech narsadan kam bo‘lmagan narsa kabi quradi. Uch nuqta: “Reading builds empathy — you live other lives. Reading builds focus — attention is a muscle. Reading builds freedom — an informed mind cannot be manipulated.” — uch anaphora. Yakun: “So tonight, I ask for one thing: one page. One page tonight — that is all.” — bugun kechasi bitta narsa so‘rayman: bitta sahifa. Hamma narsa shu. Eslab qoling: bu namuna — sizning mavzungiz boshqacha bo‘ladi — lekin skelet — ochilish, uch nuqta, callback — aynan shu.
scenes.say: Only one in five teenagers finished a book last year. Reading builds empathy, reading builds focus, reading builds freedom. So tonight, one page. That is all I ask.
scenes.say_uz: Besh yoshdan faqat bittasi o‘tgan yili kitob tugatdi. O‘qish empatiya quradi, o‘qish e’tibor quradi, o‘qish ozodlik quradi. Xo‘sh, bugun kechasi — bitta sahifa. Men sizdan shuni so‘rayman, xolos.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
scenes.say_native: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik? Nutq anatomiyasi — hook, thesis, uch nuqta, callback; ritorik usullar — anaphora, uchlik qoidasi, ritorik savol, antithesis, metafora; ovoz rejissyori — sur’at, pauzalar, urg‘u; tinglovchini jalb qilish — “you”, savollar, hikoyalar, “we”; esda qoladigan yakun — callback, call to action, bitta quotable line. Endi siz nafaqat gapirasiz — ishontirasiz.
scenes.say: Today you learned speech anatomy, rhetorical devices, pace and pauses, audience engagement and memorable conclusions — you are ready to persuade, not just speak.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun nutq anatomiyasi, ritorik usullar, sur’at va pauzalar, tinglovchini jalb qilish va esda qoladigan yakunni o‘rgandingiz — endi siz shunchaki gapirmaysiz, ishontirasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. 4 daqiqalik ishontiruvchi nutqni to‘liq yozing, keyin ikki marta ovoz chiqarib ayting va yozib oling — birinchi yozib olishda urg‘u va pauzalarni belgilang, ikkinchisini toza ayting. Keyingi darsda ochiq bahs va panellarni boshqarishni o‘rganamiz — moderatorlik — notiqlikning keyingi bosqichi. Goodbye!
scenes.say: Homework: write and record a four-minute persuasive speech, marking pace and pauses in the first take. Next lesson: moderating discussions and panels. Goodbye!
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: to‘rt daqiqalik ishontiruvchi nutqni yozing va yozib oling — birinchi marta urg‘u va pauzalarni belgilang. Keyingi dars: munozarani boshqarish. Xayr!

homework_uz: 4 daqiqalik ishontiruvchi nutqni to‘liq yozing va ikki marta yozib oling — birinchi yozib olishda sur’at va pauzalarni belgilang, ikkinchisini toza ayting. Keyingi dars: Munozarani boshqarish.

quiz.why_uz: Odam miyasi uchlikni oson eslab qoladi.
Masalan “We will fight…, we will fight…” — ritm yaratadi.

quiz.q: Tinglovchini jalb qilishning eng samarali usuli?
quiz.why_uz: Faktlar aytadi, hikoyalar ishontiradi va esda qoladi.

options: bir xil ohang — zerikarli va ta’sirsiz
quiz.why_uz: Balandlik, sur’at va urg‘u — ovoz asboblari.

options: javob kutilmaydi — tinglovchi ichida javob beradi
quiz.why_uz: Savol o‘ylashga majbur qiladi — ichki konsensus.
Tinglovchiga nima qilishni ayting: “Tonight, one page.”
Thesis bir gapli bo‘lsa — butun nutq unga xizmat qiladi.
